defects.class: provider-controlled length used for a fixed-size stack buffer (out-of-bounds write)
defects.description: ossl_cms_EncryptedContent_init_bio filled unsigned char iv[EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH] with ivlen = EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_iv_length(ctx) bytes and later copied ivlen bytes into aparams.iv. A provider may advertise an ivlen larger than EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH, so the authority (cms_enc.c:96-98,179) overruns its stack buffer. The conversion reproduced that authority UB.
defects.fix: Refuse an ivlen outside 0..=EVP_MAX_IV_LENGTH with ERR_R_EVP_LIB at the authority's own IV-length coordinate, recording the deliberate §17 divergence. Added control cms::cms_enc::tests::iv_length_guard_rejects_a_provider_iv_larger_than_the_buffer. The end-to-end custom-provider reproducer remains NOT_RUN.

defects.description: The recipient stack was released with OPENSSL_sk_free, which frees only the stack array. apps/smime.c:726 uses OSSL_STACK_OF_X509_free (pop-free with X509_free), so every certificate pushed for -encrypt was leaked.
defects.fix: Every encerts release now calls crate::x509::t_x509::OSSL_STACK_OF_X509_free, matching the authority's element destructor.

defects.class: owned BIO leak on success and every failure path
defects.description: indata, the content BIO produced by SMIME_read_PKCS7_ex, was never released. apps/smime.c:744 frees it on every path.
defects.fix: Each cleanup/return path after the read now calls the NULL-safe BIO_free(indata), matching the authority's single end: label.

defects.class: unchecked stack insertion (unpushed certificate and stack leak)
defects.description: OPENSSL_sk_push's result was ignored. On refusal the authority's goto end releases the certificate it did not push and the stack (apps/smime.c:517-521,723-745).
defects.fix: The push result is checked; failure frees the unpushed certificate and the stack.

defects.class: latent double release through a raw struct copy (authority refusal omitted)
defects.description: ecdsa_dupctx omitted the authority's kinv != NULL || r != NULL refusal (ecdsa_sig.c:634-638). Those fields stay NULL without the ACVP test arm, but any future assignment would make CRYPTO_memdup alias two BIGNUMs and freectx release each of them twice.
defects.fix: Restored the authority's refusal before the raw copy.
